text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm in Seoul this week for a conference, landing late (~00:30). Anyone have recs for late-night chimaek vs soondae near Gangnam? Need somewhere open past midnight, casual/outdoor preferred. thx!

jun: Try 'Hanaro Pocha' near Gangnam station — basically 24/7 vibes, great chimaek and spicy dakgalbi. Address: 강남구 테헤란로4길 10.

alex: If you want proper soondae, 'Mokdong Bunsik' does a killer soondae guk and the fries with blood sausage are a godsend. Usually open until ~02:00. Bring cash.

srini: Here's a map pin I used last time: https://maps.app.goo.gl/EXAMPLE — tiny family-run pocha, perfect fried chicken and beer. Expect a line on Friday nights.

elaine: @maria also consider 'YOLO 24' (basement spot) — weird combo karaoke + chicken but open super late and fun for a small group. Not for vegans tho.

maria: Amazing recs — thanks! Any halal or veg-friendly late options nearby? My friend can't do pork.

kim: For veg-forward late stuff, 'Plant' in Gangnam does delivery after 23:00 sometimes (call ahead). Halal-ish option: 'Emaan Halal' stays open late-ish on weekends, but close times vary — DM me and I can text the number.

jun: :thumbsup: Also FYI metro stops running ~01:30 on weekdays so plan for a cab if you stay out. Taxis are cheap though.

maria: Good to know. Will probably pick one of these and share final spot after I land. Appreciate it!

foodbot: Reminder (unrelated): company offsite pizza party this Friday 18:00 in Soma kitchen :pizza: — drop by if you're local.
